description: A knot of coherent thought.  Burns steady and clean.
A mote of your own coherent thought, hanging in the air and giving off steady light.  It will burn out in a few hours.
The cold cinder of a burned-out thought.  Useless now.
Bread you remembered so hard it became real.  Nourishing and deeply satisfying, and it goes down like cool spring water, but it unravels back into stray notions within half a day.
A blade of ossified thought.  Keen enough for real work, though no master smith would call it great.

name: Perfect Clarity
desc: Your mind runs like a cooled engine.  Everything is obvious.

name: Mental Strain
desc: Your head throbs from forcing thoughts into matter.  Conjure less, rest more.

effect.u_message: You release the half-formed thought.
The world goes quiet and obvious.
Steel remembers being ore.  You remind it.
Scrap metal condenses out of the air.
Copper wire unspools from nothing.
Wire draws itself through your fingers.
Dead circuits precipitate around you.
A etched circuit resolves out of static.
A processor.  You thought very carefully about this one.
Memory sticks, remembered into being.
A power supply hums into existence.
Solder wire coils at your feet.
Charcoal.  Easy.  Barely worth thinking about.
Lye powder sifts down like snow.
Two rolls of duct tape.  Civilization in a tube.
Leather stretches itself flat before you.
Fur, warm as if just shed.
A fistful of nails.
Springs boing into being.
Pipes clang onto the ground.
Plastic chunks, fresh from the idea of oil.
Thread spools itself.
Six lengths of two-by-four.  Framing for a new world.
Logs, still smelling of sap that never existed.
Wood panels, grain and all.
Heavy beams.  Your shoulders ache just looking at them.
A fistful of nails.
Rocks.  Simple, honest rocks.
Rebar, straight as an equation.
Bricks, warm from the kiln of your mind.
Thirty feet of rope, coiled and ready.
Glass sheets.  Try not to think about breaking them.
A tarp.  Shelter is a thought away.
Sticks.  Every project starts with sticks.

effect.fail_message: The door in your mind refuses to open.
effect.success_message: You step sideways into your own head.

effect.u_message: You are home.  This place is yours.

effect.fail_message: You feel a prickle at the edge of your senses.
effect.success_message: The palace folds away behind your eyes.

effect.u_message: Back where you left.
You condense a mote of coherent thought.  It hangs in the air, glowing.
You remember bread so hard it becomes real.
You think a blade into being.  It hums faintly.

effect.spawn_message: A servant pulls itself out of your thoughts.
effect.spawn_message_plural: Servants pull themselves out of your thoughts.

description: A toolbox you remembered so hard it became real.  It holds the shape of every hand tool you have ever held, all at once.  Light, unbreakable, and always exactly what the job needs.  (Stations still need building: forge, anvil, oven, workbench.)

effect.u_message: You remember every toolbox you have ever opened, all at once.  It is heavy with possibility.
Pipe fittings, threaded true.
Sheet metal, flat with promise.
Small sheets for small jobs.
Nuts and bolts, matched pairs.
Cable, coiled and patient.
An amplifier, humming faintly.
A solar cell, still warm from some sun.
Strong glue.  Do not think about your fingers.
Paper, blank and obedient.
Plastic sheeting, crinkling into being.
Clay, cool and willing.
Rubber chunks, bouncing back.
Tanned hide, supple as memory.
Tanned pelt, soft with winter.
Cotton sheeting, clean and square.
Patchwork, stitched from scraps of thought.
Kevlar scraps, stubborn as ever.
A chumbrega one-lung engine.  It runs.
A four-cylinder workhorse.
A small electric motor, eager to spin.
A large electric motor with ambitions.
A small steam engine.  Feed it coal.
A triple-expansion steam engine, hissing softly.
Steering, pedals, and hope.
A seat with most of its springs.
Bare frames, waiting for purpose.
A charged-enough car battery.
Two honest wheels.
